results.rationale: The coffee cup and wooden table remain recognizable, but the paper is narrowed and a large open case is added across it. The original pen holder stays at upper left, with none moved to the lower-right paper corner. The added case contains several warped, fused and semantically unclear implements.

The glass dish and white backdrop remain, but the apples have different skin colors, shapes and orientations beyond a count change. Six apples remain instead of the required single apple. The edited fruit, stems, reflections and glass dish are visually coherent and artifact-free.
